description: This file contains the main activity class for an Android searchable dictionary app. It manages search intents, displays search results in a list, and handles user interactions with search suggestions and search bar integration.
external_files: R.java (reference to resources like layouts, strings, ids)

classes.name: SearchableDictionary
classes.description: Main activity class for handling search, displaying results, and user interactions in the dictionary app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and handles the incoming intent.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents when activity is launched with launchMode="singleTop".

methods.name: handleIntent
methods.description: Processes the intent for search or view actions and triggers appropriate responses.

methods.name: showResults
methods.description: Performs the query on the content provider, updates UI with results, and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and configures the search view for API levels >= HONEYCOMB.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically initiating a search when the search menu item is clicked.
